stories.headline: Aug. 7 marked 90th anniversary of Spanish ‘execution’ of Sacred Heart of Jesus statue
stories.summary: Believers recently remembered nine decades since a monument dedicated to Christ’s Sacred Heart was symbolically targeted for execution in Spain. By late autumn of 1936, Nationalist troops reclaimed the grounds. Guided by General José Enrique Varela, the soldiers gathered alongside an army chaplain to attend a solemn Mass seeking spiritual restoration.
